description: Fork of exp018 (E=64, H=6, d_qk=32, sep Q/K, 16k steps → 1.7411). Two changes: n_steps 16000 → 8000, device_batch_size 8 → 32. Effective batch grows 4× (4096 → 16384 tokens/step); total tokens seen across the run = 8000 × 16384 = 131M (vs exp018's 16000 × 4096 = 65M, ~2× more data). Tests: does bigger batch + fewer steps beat exp018's 1.7411? The H=6/big-heads geometry has been the stable SOTA at 16k; this asks whether shorter, larger-batch training with same total compute can match it.
